title: Invariant fingerprint selected Mirror bank
hypothesis: Source-only invariant fingerprints select code families that lower total stored task-bank bytes >=10% versus best output-probe or SVD clustering at held-out loss difference <=0.01 nats/token, with zero false equivalences under prescribed counterexamples.
physical_object: shared pretrained model plus a bank of candidate adaptation bases
mirror_coordinate: fingerprint-selected basis index plus small m and optional paid private residual
logical_multiplicity: many naturally trained tasks mapped into fewer task-code/basis families
closest_controls: output-probe clustering / weight-SVD clustering / bispectral-only invariant test / independent adapters

requirements.native: Reproduce a task-delta SVD + nearest-codebook and a function-logit probe clustering baseline; if canonical bispectral computation from PA384 is unavailable, label any simplified spectral signature as a PROXY, not native replication.
requirements.insertion: Select basis family using a gauge-invariant signature estimated on source/calibration data; train per-task m on support data and store basis index. The selector, tables and signal samples used at inference count if needed online.
requirements.method: Generate source task delta functions and multiple exact Q/K, V/O gauge copies. Make feature sets: raw Frobenius/SVD, held-out calibration logits, curvature/Fisher sketch, and full bispectral signature only if independently implemented/validated. Cluster on source; fit m with frozen source basis; include a negative pair with identical low-order moments but different outputs.
requirements.fixture: Eight source task families x 3 gauge twins, six truly new held-out tasks, and two adversarial near-collision families using tiny attention/MLP blocks; target adapters are learned independently but share the identical frozen base revision.
requirements.hardware: Stage 1 CPU float64 invariance checks and torch float32 training; stage 2 GPU natural independently learned adapter bank only if checkpoint provenance identical.

development.allowed: select code dimension, LR, stop condition only

resources.compute: training examples and updates, FLOPs or MACs, CPU/GPU P50/P95 with batch/dtype/hardware
resources.quality: False same-function/equivalence decisions, held-out NLL/accuracy and logits, bank basis count, actual compressed bytes including signature/selector indices, inference CPU latency and source-training time.

gates.PASS: Across five fresh seeds, no confirmed functionally different pair merged as exact equivalent, held-out NLL within +0.01 of best byte-near control, >=10% bank byte saving and P95 inference <=1.10 control; otherwise at most PROMISING for screening.
gates.FAIL: Any false-equivalence decision using ground-truth synthetic exact functions; audit-task delta used to form source basis; simple output clustering equal/better at matched bytes.
gates.UNCERTAIN: Missing strong control, uncertain precision, insufficient heldout data, unmeasured runtime or CI overlap

alternative: Gauge invariant fingerprint may be too coarse, expensive or non-identifying; output-space clustering can dominate.
uncertainty: Calibration coverage and fingerprint collisions, condition number, signature truncation, oracle-equivalence testing limitations; bootstrap by task identity and report collision confidence interval.
stopping: Stop after 3 dev seeds then 5 fresh worlds; if cheap mechanism fails predeclared gate, record negative and do not tune fresh. Hardware unavailable => BLOCKED (not PASS).
prior_art_delta: Use hybrid function/gauge invariants to choose the cheapest Mirror code bank that preserves task quality; equivalence signatures alone are native prior art.
limitations: No claim that signatures completely characterize global transformer equivalence; diagnostic finite-probe score only.

uncertainty_model.observable: Quality Q in its declared units (nat/token or dimensionless error), task/seed paired samples
uncertainty_model.combined_standard: u_c=sqrt(u_seed^2+u_eval^2+u_num^2) for independent components; include covariance otherwise
uncertainty_model.expanded: U=k_cov*u_c; only indicative with 5 worlds, bootstrap interval primary
uncertainty_model.storage: actual byte count is exact for fixed serialization
uncertainty_model.sequential_stop: perform all five frozen fresh worlds, do not early-stop for favorable result or tune on audit data
